correctness.rationale: The block-diagonalized nilpotent F(s)=[[0,D(s)],[0,0]] on l2(K)⊕l2(K) satisfies all products zero and has norm sup_{f in K}|f(s)|. Equicontinuity from norm compactness yields operator norm-continuity even for uncountable K. Coefficients v_f conjugate(a_f) are absolutely summable; a diagonal unitary aligns phases and reduces the l1 sum to the sharp q-numerical radius c(rho)=(1+sqrt(1-rho²))/2 of a square-zero contraction. Balanced absolute convexity gives the upper inclusion. An explicit 2-coordinate extremal pair at every rho, followed by phase adjustment, gives the reverse inclusion, including rho=0 and 1. A separate exact scalar witness was checked at rho=0,.1,.5,.8,1. Nonseparability and inner-product phase convention are explicitly allowed.
